name: Handling Transitions Between Rooms and Flooring Types in Redmond
title-tag: Flooring Transitions Between Rooms: A Redmond, WA Guide
meta-description: Where should a refinish stop? A Redmond contractor on doorway lines, wood-to-tile and wood-to-carpet transitions, height fixes, and why connected rooms match.
post-summary: December 30, 2026 · A refinish should end where the floor already ends — under a door, at tile, at carpet — never mid-field. How we handle each transition type in Redmond’s 90s–2000s homes, the hardware that belongs at each seam, and why refinishing connected hardwood as one job is the transition that beats them all.
